Class CurrentUserArgumentResolver

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.iam.base.user.CurrentUserArgumentResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.web.method.support.HandlerMethodArgumentResolver
public class CurrentUserArgumentResolver extends Object implements org.springframework.web.method.support.HandlerMethodArgumentResolver
从当前请求的 Session 注入 USER，并把 USER 唯一的 PlatformPrincipal 绑定到 `Call`。
